title: Listen: Why can’t Europe offer Ukraine an alternative to Starlink?
lede: Ukraine’s war effort depends heavily on two American tools: Starlink and Starshield. Both belong to Elon Musk’s SpaceX, and both can be switched off. Europe says it wants to reduce that dependence.
